props.name: tex
props.description: The formula, in the TeX subset described on the page: fractions, roots, scripts, Greek, big operators, matrices, \text.

props.name: display
props.description: Set on its own line, centred and full size. Off, it sits in a line of text.

props.name: render
props.description: `auto` draws MathML where the browser can and falls back to a linear text form where it cannot. `mathml` and `text` force one or the other.

props.name: onError
props.description: Called with the message when the formula cannot be parsed.
